source_snapshot.items: Restrict avahi functionality to eth0 only via checking journactl
source_snapshot.procedure: SSH to BMC and run `journalctl | grep -i avahi` to ensure Avahi works only on eth0.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds and Avahi works only on eth0.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; uses insecure SSH and raw journal grep, which cannot alone prove current exclusive binding.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; adds authoritative interface mapping, effective Avahi config, runtime sockets/multicast membership and boot-scoped journal evidence.

old_problem: Journal text is historical and may be incomplete; an empty or eth0-only grep does not prove there is no silent listener/advertisement on another interface. The physical role of eth0 and bridge/VLAN exceptions were unspecified.
disposition_reason: Avahi configuration, systemd journal, interface inventory and runtime socket/multicast state are standard read-only evidence. ED-03/15/20 allow the platform's eth0-to-port map and bridge/VLAN/loopback policy as project configuration. Correlating all channels yields a defensible exclusivity oracle without restarting or editing networking.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2233, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2234 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00016-V001 / 69c6abcdd532e877 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind BMC firmware/OS/boot ID and the complete interface/bridge/VLAN map, including the physical role of eth0 and allowed loopback behavior.
Retain the source journal check but scope it to the approved boot/time window and preserve complete unit output/exit status.
Read effective Avahi configuration/unit state plus current IP links/addresses, listeners and multicast memberships; resolve every active advertisement/bind to the approved map.
An empty grep, stopped service or log rotation is not proof of correct confinement unless the project policy explicitly permits Avahi disabled/absent.
Use trusted secret-safe BMC console access; preserve raw evidence and explicit non-eth0/exception findings.
Do not restart Avahi, edit config, flap interfaces, inject advertisements or clear logs; stop on ambiguity or incomplete evidence.
No login, journal/config/socket command, network/service mutation, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC Avahi confinement to approved eth0 path
test_case.purpose: Verify that BMC mDNS/DNS-SD is configured and operating only on the approved physical/logical eth0 path and not on any other active interface.
required_package: BMC firmware/OS/boot identity and trusted console access
Avahi unit/config paths, enabled-state policy and approved journal/runtime oracle
Read-only journalctl, systemctl/config, ip and socket/multicast inspection tools
test_case.test_command: On the verified BMC, capture boot-scoped Avahi journal output, effective configuration and unit status, complete interface/address inventory, and current listener/multicast/advertisement state. Resolve every active path against the signed topology and require only the approved eth0 path, without restarting or changing service/network state.
test_case.expected_result: All required commands succeed; Avahi's effective policy, journal activity and every current listener/multicast/advertisement resolve exclusively to approved eth0 or explicitly allowed logical members, with no unexplained non-eth0 activity.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete configuration, current runtime and scoped journal evidence plus authoritative interface resolution. Grep-only or empty output cannot pass. Any unapproved non-eth0 binding/advertisement, ambiguous alias, incomplete evidence or command error is FAIL or execution-blocking as documented.
safety_gate: Verify BMC identity and authoritative interface map before interpreting kernel names.
Read-only inspection only; no service restart, config edit, interface flap, advertisement injection or log clear.
Stop on wrong target, alias ambiguity, permission failure or incomplete current-state evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC firmware/OS/boot ID and full signed interface map
Complete scoped Avahi journal plus command exits
Effective Avahi configuration and unit status
Per-interface physical-role resolution, exception evaluation and no-mutation audit
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On access or evidence failure, close the session and preserve output; do not restart or edit Avahi/networking to manufacture a result.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently requires Avahi eth0-only behavior; the journalctl misspelling does not alter intent.

blocked.reason: Read-only Linux evidence is standard; topology/exception bindings are project configuration.
